sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
💰 Prosperity Meets Protection - Pyrite supports abundance and success energy, while Black Obsidian helps protect against negativity.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🧿 Two Bracelets, One Purpose - Wear them together for balanced energy or separately based on your day and intention.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 ✨ Bold Everyday Styling - The metallic Pyrite and glossy Black Obsidian combination gives a premium, powerful look.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🎁 Ideal Gifting Choice - A meaningful combo that makes a thoughtful gift for success, protection, and personal growth.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
-> Best Day to Wear: Wear the Pyrite Bracelet on Thursday morning for prosperity energy and the Black Obsidian Bracelet on Saturday morning for protection and grounding.

-> Recharge: Recharge your black obsidian and pyrite bracelet by placing it under full moonlight overnight. Cleanse beforehand using dry sea salt in a bowl. Avoid water for pyrite. Set positive intentions while removing absorbed negative energies gently and respectfully each cycle.

-> Cleansing: Once you receive your crystal, it is essential to do a cleansing and activating ritual to make this crystal YOURS! For that keep it immersed in simple salt for 5-10 minutes.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Introducing a powerful blend of Black Obsidian and Pyrite Bracelets, created to bring together two distinct energies that support your daily life in different ways.

Black Obsidian works as a strong protective shield, helping you stay away from negativity and unwanted energetic influences. It supports emotional grounding and keeps your energy space clear and stable. On the other hand, Pyrite, often known as the “money magnet,” is associated with wealth attraction, confidence, and success. It is believed to support not just financial growth, but also recognition and overall achievement in life.

When worn together, these crystals create a balanced synergy—one focuses on protection, while the other drives ambition and abundance. This combination is designed for people who want to move forward in life while staying energetically protected and focused.

Recognized as India’s Most-Loved Crystal Bracelet Combo and crafted by The Pyrite Man of India, it has reached 2+ million units sold and is trusted by over 1+ million users. Each piece is made using authentic, lab-tested crystals.

✨ Get ready to be called “Riche Rich”

Kindly note that images are just a graphical representation of crystals. Size, Shape and Colour may vary at the time of delivery.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Is it made from real crystals?

Yes, each bracelet is handcrafted using authentic, lab-tested Obsidian and Pyrite crystals.

2. Who can wear the Riche Rich Bracelet?

It can be worn by anyone seeking protection, luck, and prosperity — suitable for both men and women.

3. On which hand should I wear it?

Wear on your left hand to absorb positive energy and block negativity.

4. Can I wear it daily?

Absolutely! The bracelet is designed for everyday use and pairs well with any outfit.

5. How do I cleanse my bracelet?

You can cleanse it using selenite crystal recharging plate or keep it under moonlight.
